purpose: Explicit creator preview/publish selection and published-link sharing through the authenticated worker channel
limitations: Operator-prepared catalog only; no arbitrary-app launch or provisioning.
Returned eligibility and acknowledged selection are not observed gateway or application health.
Browser release metadata is controlled; actual SQL/approval/session/Socket.IO guards are exercised.
Clipboard is mocked in unit tests; compiled browser checks do not change the operating-system clipboard.
Unconfirmed writes may have committed and require explicit reconciliation before retry.
Bounded AWS resources, initial bootstrap, actual persistence/redeploy/revocation and teardown remain release gates.
No production flag, migration, AWS resource, provider connection, account, invitation email, merge or deployment changed.
